Services Offered Administration of Delinquent Tax process according to PA 206. Oversees the printing process for current year taxes. Distributes tax notices to local townships for collection. Custodian of all tax rolls. Process Board of Review changes, Michigan Tax Tribunal changes, Department of Treasury changes, and PRE Denials for prior tax years and issues tax refunds when necessary. Issues dog licenses: Please enter 4 zeros for the license number to search for your account. Renew online at https://app.midoglicense.org/benzie Manages deposits and investments for all County money transmitted by all Departments, Health Dept, Road Commission, and The Maples. Maintains the County's General Ledger. Provides support to the Benzie County Department of Veterans Affairs. Grant administration. Description The County Treasurer is the Chairperson of the County Land Bank Authority and is a member of the County Elections Commission, County Plat Board, Frankfort City-County Airport Authority, and the Fee Committee. The County Treasurer is also an ex-officio member of the Budget and Finance Committee, County Building Authority, EMS Advisory Committee, and the County Veterans Affairs Committee.
